name: Rolling Like a Ball
description: Curled into a ball and balanced on your tailbone, roll back to your shoulder blades and back up to balance again.

source.title: Rolling Like a Ball on the Mat (Online Pilates Classes)
source.note: Classic Pilates mat exercise, described in our own words for this library. Stick-figure approximation.

setup: Sit and hug your shins, feet off the mat, chin tucked, back rounded like a ball.
cues: Keep the ball shape the same the whole time.
Roll only to your shoulder blades, never your neck.
Use your stomach to stop at the top.

prescription.note: Move with your breath, slowly and with control.

keyframes.name: Balance
keyframes.cue: Curled up, balancing on your tailbone.

keyframes.name: Roll back
keyframes.cue: Roll back to your shoulder blades.
